authority: #K2-427 sec.4: content-aware allocation composing the in-register yield (R1210) + corridor redraw (R1222).
finding: composing the in-register yield (R1210) + corridor redraw (R1222) into the PER-NET allocator still gives 2/5: the 3 UNPLACEABLE nets' own-endpoint boxes are boxed. The reading that reached 5/5 (R1220/R1222) grouped the endpoints into ROWS and used the ROW box - i.e. the policy's 'group fanout' grouping, not per-net boxes.
next: allocate by ROW (the reference's group fanout), not per net, and keep the per-channel conservation.
